contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ IMP ANTONINVS PIVS AVG ; R/ COSIIIPP [?M?]TRPIIII

Silver coin. Roman denarius of Caracalla (198-217), pierced at 1 O'clock obverse, from that side. Reece period 10. This coin was not located in RIC and might be a contemporary copy. Obverse description: Bust laureate left, beardless. Obverse inscription: IMP ANTONINVS PIVS AVG. Reverse description: Robed figure standing left holding cornucopiae and pointing downwards with wand. Pitted in centre…
